function identity<const T>(value: T): T { return value; }
const object = identity({ kind: 'a', nested: { count: 1 } });
object.kind = 'a';
object.nested.count = 1;
const tuple = identity(['a', 'b']);
tuple.push('a');
const wrong: 'b' = object.kind;
const input = { kind: 'a' };
const widened: 'a' = identity(input).kind;
function mutable<const T extends string[]>(value: T): T { return value; }
mutable(['a', 'b']).push('c');
function ordinary<T>(value: T): T { return value; }
const ordinaryLiteral: 'a' = ordinary({ kind: 'a' }).kind;
